local states: { [Player]: State } = {}
local requestRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil
local resultRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil
local started = false

local juiceService: any = nil
local juiceTried = false

-- Lazily resolves JuiceService (it may be created after this module loads).
local function getJuice(): any
	if juiceService then
		return juiceService
	end
	if juiceTried then
		return nil
	end
	local mod = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("JuiceService") or ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("JuiceService", 5)
	juiceTried = true
	if not mod then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, res = pcall(require, mod)
	if ok then
		juiceService = res
	else
		warn("RebirthService: could not require JuiceService: " .. tostring(res))
	end
	return juiceService
end

local function notifyJuice(player: Player)
	local juice = getJuice()
	if not juice then
		return
	end
	if type(juice.onRebirth) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(juice.onRebirth, player)
		if not ok then
			warn("RebirthService: JuiceService.onRebirth failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	if type(juice.pushGoal) == "function" then
		-- After a reset the cheapest unbought upgrade is Dropper 2.
		local goalName = "Dropper 2"
		local goalCost: number? = nil
		if type(UpgradeService.costOf) == "function" then
			local okCost, c = pcall(UpgradeService.costOf, goalName)
			if okCost and type(c) == "number" then
				goalCost = c
			end
		end
		local ok, err = pcall(juice.pushGoal, player, goalName, goalCost)
		if not ok then
			warn("RebirthService: JuiceService.pushGoal failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
end

local function getRemote(folder: Instance, name: string): RemoteEvent
	local existing = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return existing
	end
	local r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	r.Name = name
	r.Parent = folder
	return r
end

local function getCash(player: Player): IntValue?
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not ls then
		return nil
	end
	local c = ls:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if c and (c:IsA("IntValue") or c:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return c :: any
	end
	return nil
end

local function ensureState(player: Player): State
	local s = states[player]
	if not s then
		s = { rebirths = 0, last = 0, altar = nil, label = nil, stat = nil }
		states[player] = s
		player:SetAttribute("RebirthMult", RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(0))
	end
	return s
end

local function updateLabel(s: State)
	if s.label then
		s.label.Text = "REBIRTH\n$" .. tostring(RebirthConfig.costFor(s.rebirths))
			.. "\nNext: x" .. RebirthConfig.formatMultiplier(RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(s.rebirths + 1))
	end
end

local function fireResult(player: Player, ok: boolean, s: State, reason: string)
	if resultRemote then
		resultRemote:FireClient(player, ok, RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(s.rebirths), RebirthConfig.costFor(s.rebirths), reason)
	end
end

function RebirthService.tryRebirth(player: Player)
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end
	local s = ensureState(player)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - s.last < RebirthConfig.requestCooldown then
		return
	end
	s.last = now

	local cash = getCash(player)
	local cost = RebirthConfig.costFor(s.rebirths)
	local hasAll = false
	if type(UpgradeService.hasAll) == "function" then
		local okCall, res = pcall(UpgradeService.hasAll, player)
		hasAll = okCall and res == true
	end
	local eligible = hasAll or (cash ~= nil and cash.Value >= cost)
	if not eligible or cash == nil then
		fireResult(player, false, s, "Need $" .. tostring(cost) .. " or every upgrade")
		ForgeTelemetry.count("rebirth_denied", 1)
		return
	end

	cash.Value = 0
	if type(UpgradeService.resetPlayer) == "function" then
		local okReset, err = pcall(UpgradeService.resetPlayer, player)
		if not okReset then
			warn("RebirthService: resetPlayer failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	s.rebirths += 1
	if s.stat then
		s.stat.Value = s.rebirths
	end
	player:SetAttribute("RebirthMult", RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(s.rebirths))
	updateLabel(s)
	fireResult(player, true, s, "ok")
	ForgeTelemetry.count("rebirths", 1)
	notifyJuice(player)
end

-- Silently sets the rebirth count (used when loading saved data): no banner, no cash reset.
function RebirthService.setRebirths(player: Player, n: number)
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end
	local count = 0
	if type(n) == "number" and n == n and n > 0 and n < math.huge then
		count = math.floor(n)
	end
	local s = ensureState(player)
	s.rebirths = count
	if s.stat then
		s.stat.Value = count
	end
	player:SetAttribute("RebirthMult", RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(count))
	updateLabel(s)
end

-- RebirthConfig: shared tunables and pure helpers for the Rebirth feature (server and client).

local RebirthConfig = {
	baseCost = 5000,
	costGrowth = 2,
	multPerRebirth = 0.5,
	requestCooldown = 1.5, -- seconds between rebirth requests per player
	altarColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40),
	altarGlowColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 150),
	altarSize = Vector3.new(4, 5, 4),
	flashDuration = 1.2, -- seconds for the full-screen golden flash
	bannerDuration = 2.5, -- seconds the 'REBIRTH x<mult>!' banner stays up
	flashColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60),
}

-- Cash required for the next rebirth, given how many rebirths were already done.
function RebirthConfig.costFor(rebirths: number): number
	local n = math.max(0, math.floor(rebirths))
	return math.floor(RebirthConfig.baseCost * RebirthConfig.costGrowth ^ n)
end

-- Permanent cash multiplier for a given number of rebirths.
function RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths: number): number
	local n = math.max(0, math.floor(rebirths))
	return 1 + RebirthConfig.multPerRebirth * n
end

-- Formats a multiplier for display, e.g. 1.5 -> "1.5", 2 -> "2.0".
function RebirthConfig.formatMultiplier(mult: number): string
	return string.format("%.1f", mult)
end

-- Banner text, e.g. "REBIRTH x1.5!".
function RebirthConfig.bannerText(rebirths: number): string
	return "REBIRTH x" .. RebirthConfig.formatMultiplier(RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths)) .. "!"
end

-- Rounded payout for a cube value after applying the multiplier.
function RebirthConfig.applyMultiplier(value: number, rebirths: number): number
	return math.floor(value * RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths) + 0.5)
end

-- Whether a player may rebirth: enough cash, or every upgrade bought.
function RebirthConfig.canRebirth(cash: number, rebirths: number, allUpgradesBought: boolean): boolean
	return allUpgradesBought or cash >= RebirthConfig.costFor(rebirths)
end

return RebirthConfig

-- Per-player upgrade modifiers (written by UpgradeService via Tycoon.setModifiers).
local modsByPlayer: { [Player]: any } = {}
local function mergeMods(mods: any): any
	local out: any = { slots = 1, ore = 1, speedMult = 1, cashMult = 1 }
	if type(mods) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(mods) do
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end
local function getOres(): any
	local mod = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Upgrades")
	if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, res = pcall(require, mod)
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then
		return (res :: any).ores
	end
	return nil
end

-- Collision groups: cubes never collide with players or each other (they still hit the conveyor/collector).
local groupsReady = false
local groupsOk = false
local function setupCollisionGroups()
	if groupsReady then
		return
	end
	groupsReady = true
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		pcall(function()
			PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(CUBE_GROUP)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(PLAYER_GROUP)
		end)
		PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(CUBE_GROUP, PLAYER_GROUP, false)
		PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(CUBE_GROUP, CUBE_GROUP, false)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("Tycoon: collision group setup failed: " .. tostring(err))
		return
	end
	groupsOk = true

	local function applyToCharacter(character: Model)
		local function setPart(inst: Instance)
			if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
				inst.CollisionGroup = PLAYER_GROUP
			end
		end
		for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			setPart(d)
		end
		character.DescendantAdded:Connect(setPart)
	end
	local function hookPlayer(p: Player)
		if p.Character then
			applyToCharacter(p.Character)
		end
		p.CharacterAdded:Connect(applyToCharacter)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlayer)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		hookPlayer(p)
	end
end

-- PlotClaimService is required lazily: it requires this module, so a top-level require would be circular.
local claimService: any = nil
local function isOwner(player: Player, plot: any): boolean
	if claimService == nil then
		local mod = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("PlotClaimService")
		if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			return false
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(require, mod)
		if not ok then
			warn("Tycoon: could not require PlotClaimService: " .. tostring(result))
			return false
		end
		claimService = result
	end
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return claimService.isOwner(player, plot)
	end)
	return ok and res == true
end

-- CashInService is required lazily and guarded so a failure there can never block payouts.
local cashInService: any = nil
local function sendCashIn(player: Player, amount: number, tier: number, position: Vector3)
	if cashInService == nil then
		local mod = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("CashInService")
		if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			return
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(require, mod)
		if not ok then
			warn("Tycoon: could not require CashInService: " .. tostring(result))
			return
		end
		cashInService = result
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		cashInService.cashIn(player, amount, tier, position)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("Tycoon: cashIn failed: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

local function getNotifyRemote(): RemoteEvent
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(Config.REMOTES_FOLDER)
	if not folder then
		local newFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		newFolder.Name = Config.REMOTES_FOLDER
		newFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		folder = newFolder
	end
	local f = folder :: Instance
	local remote = f:FindFirstChild(Config.REMOTE_NOTIFY)
	if not remote then
		local newRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		newRemote.Name = Config.REMOTE_NOTIFY
		newRemote.Parent = f
		remote = newRemote
	end
	return remote :: RemoteEvent
end

local function getCash(player: Player): IntValue?
	if not player.Parent then
		return nil
	end
	local stats: Instance? = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then
		local newStats = Instance.new("Folder")
		newStats.Name = "leaderstats"
		newStats.Parent = player
		stats = newStats
	end
	local s = stats :: Instance
	local cash: Instance? = s:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if not cash then
		local newCash = Instance.new("IntValue")
		newCash.Name = "Cash"
		newCash.Value = 0
		newCash.Parent = s
		cash = newCash
	end
	if cash and cash:IsA("IntValue") then
		return cash
	end
	return nil
end
